title: Two ways to use GPT-5
summary:
GPT-5 and GPT-5 Nano joined the text API, DeepSeek reasoning changed routes, and error handling got less brittle.

Added text-only `gpt5` for the nectar tier and `gpt-5-nano` for anonymous use. Nano accepts text and image input; both models support tools.

`deepseek-reasoning` now maps to DeepSeek R1 0528 on Vertex AI. `openai-large` moved from flower to seed, with its maximum input reduced from 9,000 to 5,000 characters. Referral links are added less often.

The text service now catches failures while sending error responses. The OpenAI-compatible client also includes the model key in request transforms and adds error diagnostics.

highlights.title: GPT-5 for text
highlights.text: Use `gpt5` for text-only requests with tool support on the nectar tier. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt5).

highlights.title: GPT-5 Nano for anonymous use
highlights.text: Use `gpt-5-nano` anonymously with text or image input and tool support. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-5-nano).

highlights.title: DeepSeek reasoning updated
highlights.text: `deepseek-reasoning` now maps to DeepSeek R1 0528 on Vertex AI. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek-reasoning).
